newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT Telecom boss to join Lucent.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT Telecom boss to join Lucent.

text.p: PTT Nederland NV said on Tuesday Ben Verwaayen, head of its PTT Telecom unit, would leave the company on September 1 to become an executive vice president of U.S. firm Lucent Technologies Inc.

The Dutch post and telecommunications group said it regretted the departure of Verwaayen, 45, adding that he had played a key role in the transformation of PTT Telecom from a state-owned enterprise to a commercial, market-oriented company.

As President International at Lucent Technologies, Verwaayen will take charge of the strategy and operations of Lucent's businesses in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia/Pacific, the Caribbean and Latin America.
PTT Nederland said it would make an announcement about Verwaayen's successor at PTT Telecom in the near future.
